description.en: In this world, witches must hunt down their magic! Deep in the forest, the terrifying king of magic and the strongest witch are locked in deadly combat. But suddenly, a young boy joins the fray. His name is Ichi and he is just a hunter. But he has the power to flip the magic world upside down in this magic hunting fantasy epic!
description.hu: Ebben a világban a különféle mágiák alakot öltöttek, ők a Varázsvalók. A Mantinel Boszorkány Egyesület boszorkányai nap mint nap azon ügyködnek, hogy levadásszák ezeket a szörnyeket, akik rettegésben tartják az embereket. Azonban váratlanul bekerül a képbe egy fiatal fiú, Ichi, akinek lételeme a vadászat. Régóta tervezgeti már egy teremtmény elejtését, viszont azt ekkor még nem sejtette, hogy a prédának kinézett lény egy Varázsvaló.
description.ja: この世界において魔法とは生き物である。そして困難な試練を乗り越え、魔法を習得するハンターたちを人は「魔女」と呼ぶ。ある日、辺境の山奥で恐るべき王の魔法（キング・ウロロ）と最強の魔女が激闘を繰り広げていた。しかしそこへ、場違いな一人の少年が乱入する。彼の名はイチ。魔女とも魔法とも縁の無い山暮らしの狩人が世界の常識をひっくり返す！
description.ru:
В этом мире ведьмы охотятся за своей магией! В глубине леса ужасающая маджика и сильнейшая ведьма схлестнулись в бою не на жизнь, а на смерть. Но вдруг к битве присоединяется молодой парнишка. Его зовут Ити, и он обычный охотник. Но у него есть сила перевернуть весь мир магии с ног на голову в этом эпохальном магическом фэнтези об охоте!

---
В этом мире ведьмы должны охотиться за своей магией! Глубоко в лесу страшный король магии и сильнейшая ведьма сошлись в смертельной схватке. Но внезапно в схватку вступает молодой парень. Его зовут Ити, и он всего лишь охотник. Но у него есть сила, способная перевернуть мир магии с ног на голову!
description.uk: У світі, де лише жінки можуть бути відьмами, один нічого не підозрюючий хлопець здобуває їхню силу. Тут відьми мусять вполювати свою магію! Там, у непроглядній гущавині лісу, жахливий володар магії та найсильніша відьма зійшлися у смертельному двобої. Аж раптом у цю запеклу сутичку вривається юний хлопчина. Його ім'я — Ічі, і він лише мисливець. Та саме йому судилося перевернути світ магії догори дригом у цій епічній сазі про полювання на чари!
description.vi: Trong thế giới này, ma pháp là một dạng sinh vật. Những người vượt qua các thử thách khó khăn và thành thạo ma pháp được gọi là “phù thủy”. Một ngày nọ, tại một vùng núi hẻo lánh, một cuộc chiến dữ dội giữa Ma Pháp Vua đáng sợ và một phù thủy cực mạnh đang diễn ra. Đây là một trận chiến thần thánh mà không ai được phép đến gần. Tuy nhiên, một cậu bé lạc lõng tên là Ichi đã chen vào cuộc chiến. Ichi là một thợ săn sống ở núi, hoàn toàn không liên quan đến ma pháp hay phù thủy. Cuối cùng, cậu bé ấy sẽ khiến cả thế giới phải kinh ngạc!
description.pt-br:
Neste mundo, as bruxas devem caçar sua magia! Nas profundezas da floresta, o terrível rei da magia e a bruxa mais forte estão presos em um combate mortal. Mas, de repente, um jovem garoto se junta à briga. Seu nome é Ichi e ele é apenas um caçador. Mas ele tem o poder de virar o mundo mágico de cabeça para baixo neste épico de fantasia de caça mágica!

---
Um mundo onde bruxas caçam magias! Nas profundezas de uma montanha remota, ocorre uma batalha feroz entre o aterrorizante Rei das Magias e a bruxa mais poderosa do mundo. Porém, em meio ao confronto, surge inesperadamente um intruso: um garoto solitário chamado Ichi. Um simples caçador da montanha, sem nenhuma conexão com bruxas ou magias, ele vira o status quo do mundo de cabeça para baixo! E assim começa uma emocionante fantasia de caça às magias!

description.en:
"This love shot up like a rocket."

Kinoshima Rocketry Club casually uploaded a test vlog of a test firing of their hybrid engine. The engine exploded — carrying away the dreams of reaching space with it — but that wasn't the only thing that exploded in that vlog. Madoi Ayame, from the engine section, who just so happened to appear in the vlog, also exploded in popularity when viewers from across the world found her cute. While she finds this bewildering, she actually has someone she wished found her cute...
description.es: "Este amor se disparó como un cohete..." Todo comenzó cuando el Club de Cohetes de Kinoshima subió casualmente un blog sobre el test de propulsión de un motor híbrido. El motor explotó... Al igual que la popularidad en internet de Madoi Ayame de la sección de motores, propulsado por su exceso de monería. Una comedia romántica adolescente sobre deambular en monería, en el espacio, y en el amor, a raíz de un video.
description.ja: ”その恋は、ロケットのように突然打ち上がった” 木ノ嶋宇宙ロケット研究部が、何気なくアップした燃焼実験を収めた一本の記録映像。 爆発したのは、宇宙への夢を載せたハイブリッドエンジンだけじゃなく、 たまたま映り込んでしまった、エンジン班「惑あやめ」のかわいさ。世界中で「かわいい」と大バズリになってしまい戸惑う、「惑あやめ」には、実は誰よりもかわいい思ってもらいたい相手がいて・・・
description.pt-br:
"Depois da escola, vagamos pelo espaço."

O Clube de Foguetes de Kinoshima postou casualmente um vlog de teste da queima de seu motor híbrido. O motor explodiu — levando junto os sonhos de alcançar o espaço — mas essa não foi a única explosão no vídeo. Madoi Ayame, da equipe de motores, que apareceu por acaso na gravação, também viralizou quando espectadores do mundo todo a acharam fofa. Embora isso a deixe confusa, há alguém em especial para quem ela realmente gostaria de parecer fofa...

Do autor de Pseudo Harem, Saitou Yuu, uma comédia romântica vibrante e cheia de juventude que nasce de um único vídeo!

description.en: The setting is Roubai Private Academy, a prestigious girls' middle school in the country. For Akebi Komichi, donning this school's sailor uniform is a dream come true. Her middle school dream life is finally beginning! Verdant open countryside vistas. The slowly flowing time of youth. With a gentle touch, the genius artist Hiro brings you this simple school tale... now enrolling!
description.es:
Akebi Komichi vive en una zona rural con su familia y acaba de conseguir entrar en la famosa Academia de secundaria Roubai, a la que ya asistió su madre. Como ella, le gustaría llevar el clásico uniforme de marinero, que ya no es el habitual en la Academia.

Después de conseguir que le permitan llevar su ansiado uniforme cosido por su madre, Akebi empezará su vida en secundaria con el objetivo de hacer muchas amigas. El paso tranquilo del tiempo, la inocencia y la naturalidad, marcarán la vida de Akebi y sus amigas.
description.ja: その“初めて”を“何度でも”──。　舞台は、田舎の名門女子中学・私立ロウ梅学園。この学園のセーラー服を着ることが「夢」だった明日小路（あけびこみち）。少女の「夢」の中学セーラー服ライフが始まる♪　広がる、緑豊かな田園風景。ゆっくり流れる青春時間。

description.en:
The Knight Commander is a symbol of the country and the people's admiration. However, in reality, her role is merely that of a front-facing middle manager, where she is merely bossed around by her superiors. One day, while working, the proud female Knight Commander, Lienna, encounters a giant dragon. She tries to fight back, but is brutally defeated, perhaps due to fatigue from her daily hard work. However, the sight she sees when she wakes up is hard to believe...!?
___

description.fr:
La capitaine des chevaliers est le symbole de toute une nation et est sujette à l'admiration de tout son peuple. Pourtant, derrière cette image héroïque se cache une réalité bien moins glorieuse : elle n'est qu'une responsable de terrain, constamment soumise aux ordres de sa hiérarchie.
 
**Lisa Lienna** ne fait pas exception. Ne souhaitant qu'un repos bien mérité, elle se voit toutefois confier une nouvelle mission de surveillance aussi banale que répétitive dans une chaîne de montagnes de la région. Sauf que cette patrouille de routine vire rapidement au cauchemar lorsqu'un dragon gigantesque surgit et l'avale avant même qu'elle ait le temps de dégainer son épée.
 
Persuadée d'avoir trouvé la mort, Lisa s'attend à ouvrir les yeux au paradis. Pourtant, c'est un tout autre monde qui l'accueille : l'intérieur du ventre d'un dragon lui-même. En son intérieur, elle y fait la rencontre d'un mystérieux individu dont les secrets semblent aussi insondables que cet étrange lieu.
 
Entre aventures, découvertes et mystères, une nouvelle vie commence au cœur d'un dragon gigantesque. Une fantasy aussi dépaysante que réconfortante, à dévorer sans modération !
description.ja: 国の象徴・民の憧れ「騎士団長」。しかしその役割は外面（そとづら）とは裏腹の中間管理職で、上司にコキ使われるだけのものであった。そんな「厄職」を背負い生きる誇り高き女騎士団長・リンナは、ある日の職務中に巨大なドラゴンに遭遇。国のため応戦するも、日々の激務の疲れがたたり、無惨にも食べられてしまった……。気が付くとそこはドラゴンの胃の中。そこでの出会いが彼女の人生を変える……！？
description.vi:
Đoàn trưởng Hiệp sĩ đoàn là biểu tượng của một quốc gia và là niềm ngưỡng mộ của người dân. Tuy nhiên, trên thực tế, vai trò của cô chỉ là một quản lý cấp trung, luôn bị cấp trên sai bảo. Một ngày nọ, trong khi làm việc, nữ Chỉ huy Hiệp sĩ kiêu hãnh Lisa Lienna chạm trán với một con rồng khổng lồ. Cô cố gắng chống trả, nhưng bị đánh bại một cách tàn bạo, có lẽ do mệt mỏi vì công việc vất vả hàng ngày. Tuy nhiên, cảnh tượng cô nhìn thấy khi tỉnh dậy thật khó tin…!?
Một câu chuyện giả tưởng “trong bụng” đầy những giấc mơ và sự chữa lành, hoàn hảo cho những ai mệt mỏi với cuộc sống thường nhật!!
description.pt-br:
A Cavaleira Comandante é um símbolo do país e da admiração do povo. No entanto, na realidade, seu papel é meramente o de uma gerente de nível médio, onde ela recebe ordens de seus superiores. Um dia, enquanto trabalhava, a orgulhosa Cavaleira Comandante, Lienna, encontra um dragão gigante. Ela tenta lutar, mas é brutalmente derrotada, talvez devido à fadiga do árduo trabalho diário. Contudo, a cena que ela vê ao acordar é difícil de acreditar…!?

Uma fantasia “dentro do estômago”, repleta de sonhos e cura, perfeita para quem está cansado da vida cotidiana!

description.en:
Katagiri Naomi, a high school student who lived alone for two years, meets a beautiful girl with black hair and blue eyes, who moves into the apartment next door. The girl's name is Yui. It seemed that she really was a noblewoman, and her nickname was "Quderella" because of her nonchalant attitude at school. Naomi knows that Yui doesn't want to depend on others, but she's actually quite naive, so Naomi decides to help her.

"Today what are we having at night... Karaage chicken, huh?"
"That's right because the price of chicken is discounted today"
"I love your fried chicken so I'm really looking forward to it"
description.id:
Kisah komedi romantis lintas budaya yang manis tentang seorang pertukaran pelajaran dari negara asing yang cantik, dan pemuda yang mengurus makan malamnya.
Katagiri Natsuomi, seorang siswa SMA yang tinggal sendiri selama dua tahun, mendapati seorang gadis cantik berambut hitam, bermata biru, yang pindah ke apartemen sebelah tempatnya. Gadis itu bernama Yui. Tampkanya dia benar-benar seorang wanita bangsawan, dan julukannya adalah “Coup de Lera” karena sikap acuh tak acuhnya di sekolah. Natsuomi mengetahui bahwa Yui tidak mau bergantung pada orang lain, tapi sebenarnya dia cukup naif, sehingga Natsuomi memutuskan untuk membantunya.
“Hari ini kita malan malam apa… Ayam goreng, ‘kah?”
“Benar, soalnya harga ayam sedang diskon hari ini”
“Aku suka ayam goreng buatanmu, jadi aku sangat menantikannya”

Ini adalah awal dari hubungan manis dan menggiurkan di antara gadis dan pemuda yang tinggal bersebelahan.

description.en:
"Hey Kuroya-kun, do you like me?"
"How did you know!?"

Unrequited love. What a shame for Kuroya, a gloomy student in high school. The other party is Kasumi Shiramori, a senior in the literature club and a transcendentally beautiful girl. While spending time alone in the club, I should have hidden this feeling for a long time...! Senior told Kuroya in desperation.

"Then -? Want to try dating me first?"

There's no way a relationship exists in the minds of these two!? No, wait, it should be like this-
___

description.ja: 「きみって私のこと好きなんでしょ？」高校２年生の黒矢総吉は、入学当初より想いを寄せる同じ文芸部の先輩・白森霞から突然そう告げられる。ふいに本心を見抜かれた黒矢は、動揺の末に告白してしまう……するとなぜか”お試し”で付き合うことに!?年上彼女にイジられまくる恥ずかしいのに嬉しい”お試し交際
description.pt-br:
"Ei, Kuroya... você gosta de mim, não é?" 
"O quê-?! Como diabos você sabia?!" 

Kuroya é um cara comum mais ou menos do colégio. Ele estava convencido de que sua paixão estava fora de seu alcance, mas ela acabara de questioná-lo sobre seus verdadeiros sentimentos... Ele agora está prestes a morrer de vergonha! A paixão em questão é Kasumi Shiramori, e ela não apenas é mais velha e a única outra integrante do clube literário, mas também é uma das belezas renomadas da escola! 

"Como ela poderia saber que eu gostava dela?" 

Kuroya pensou consigo mesmo, totalmente lívido. Claro, passamos muito tempo juntos dentro e fora do clube, mas ainda assim! 

"Então... quer sair comigo?" 

Shiramori terminou seu combo duplo com esta proposta chocante. 

"Ela também gosta de mim?! De jeito nenhum! Alguém me belisca!"

Uma das comédias românticas mais completas que existe! Como o nosso casal navegará em seu primeiro relacionamento um com o outro?

description.en:
"Hey, wanna do it?"

One late night, Yamamoto, a college student working part-time at a convenience store, reunites with Hayashi Megumi, his high school classmate and the most beautiful girl in their class. Known as the "Queen" for her strong-willed and arrogant personality, Yamamoto had always found her difficult to get along with. However, during a routine conversation, he notices painful bruises on her wrist. After learning that her boyfriend had been abusing her, Yamamoto decides to let Hayashi stay at his place...!?
description.ja: 深夜、コンビニでバイト中の大学生・山本は、高校時代の同級生・林恵と再会する。クラス一の美人でありながら勝ち気で傲慢な「女王様」だった彼女。高校時代は不仲だったが、手首の青あざを見つけたことをきっかけに、一晩だけのつもりでDV彼氏から匿う。しかし、気づけば奇妙な同棲生活が始まっていた。戸惑いながらも、互いの知らなかった一面が見えてくる二人。最悪だったはずの同棲生活は、意外と居心地が悪くない――！？
description.vi:
"Này, muốn làm không?"

Một bộ rom-com (hài lãng mạn) kể về cuộc sống chung với một "Nữ hoàng" mang đầy tổn thương — mối quan hệ không hẳn là bạn, nhưng cũng chưa hẳn là người yêu!!

Vào một đêm khuya, Yamamoto — sinh viên đại học kiêm nhân viên bán thời gian tại một cửa hàng tiện lợi — tình cờ gặp lại Hayashi Megumi, bạn cùng lớp cấp ba và cũng là cô gái xinh đẹp nhất lớp ngày ấy.
Hayashi từng được mệnh danh là "Nữ hoàng" nhờ tính cách mạnh mẽ và kiêu ngạo, khiến Yamamoto lúc nào cũng cảm thấy khó gần. Thế nhưng, trong một lần trò chuyện bình thường, anh bất chợt nhìn thấy những vết bầm tím đau đớn trên cổ tay cô.
Sau khi biết được bạn trai cô đang ngược đãi cô, Yamamoto quyết định để Hayashi tạm thời ở lại chỗ mình...!?
description.pt-br:
Durante a madrugada, Yamamoto, um universitário que trabalha meio período em uma loja de conveniência, reencontra Hayashi Megumi, sua colega do ensino médio — a garota mais bonita da turma, conhecida como a “Rainha” por seu jeito orgulhoso e arrogante.

Ao perceber hematomas em seu pulso e descobrir que ela sofre abuso do namorado, ele decide escondê-la por uma noite. Mas, antes que percebam, os dois já estão vivendo juntos — e conhecendo lados um do outro que nunca imaginaram.

Just as he was getting ready to start a new life back home, he met a beautiful and innocent high school girl, who turned out to be Haruyama Miya, one of the little girls (brats) Isamu used to play with when he was young. description.en: One day, 22-year-old Kanzaki Misuzu is mysteriously dragged into another world. Based on the status screen she can access, it seems she's entered some kind of RPG as a magic user! Luckily for her, she can use the gaming skills she acquired as an otaku to make her way in this new world. But before she knew it, people started calling her "the Black Healer"!!
description.pt: Um dia, Kanzaki Misuzu de 22 anos, de repente é transportada para um mundo estranho. Com base nas telas que ela pode acessar, parece que ela entrou em algum tipo de RPG como um usuário mágico! Felizmente, ela pode usar as habilidades de jogo que ela adquiriu como uma otaku para guiar ela nesse novo mundo. Mas antes que ela saiba, as pessoas começaram a chamá-la de " The Black Healer "!!
description.ru: Героиня сей манги – заядлая отаку, любительница сёдзё-манги и историй о перерождениях в иных мирах. Возвращаясь домой с очередной аниме-пати, главная героиня по странному стечению обстоятельств была насильно затянута в иной мир. Поняв, что что-то не так, девушка начинает осматривать местность, попутно замечая способность к применению магии. Подумав, что это уж до боли что-то напоминает, и окончательно убедившись, что это уже не её родной мир, она понимает, что сидя сложа руки ничего не добьётся. И вот на этой ноте наша героиня отправляется на поиски пропитания и временной жилплощади.

description.en:
Ryuuto Kashima is a gloomy high school student. Because of a punishment game, he was forced to confess to Runa Shirakawa, a girl from the top of school caste and admired by everyone. They ended up going out for the unexpected reason of "Err, I'm free now so..." but, Ryuuto ends up following and eavesdropping Runa getting confessed by a handsome soccer club member, and Runa bringing Ryuuto, whom she just started dating, to her own room as a matter of course.

They have different friends and ways to have fun, different in just about everything. And yet, surprised by their differences everyday, accepting it, they begin to relate with each other.

When she carefully reads the shape of his mouth, she finds that he is actually saying nothing but nonsense...?
description.ja: 柊月乃は生まれつき耳が聞こえない。そんな彼女が転校先で出会ったのは、おしゃべりな男子・榎本太陽。聞こえないことなんかお構いなしにしゃべりかけてくる太陽に若干引き気味な月乃。よくよく口の形を読んでみると、実はしょーもないことしか言ってなくないこの人…？
description.ru: Хиираги Цукино родилась глухой. Когда она переводится в новую школу, она встречает говорливого мальчика по имени Эномото Тайо. Цукино немного обескуражена тем, что Тайо разговаривает с ней, не заботясь о том, что она не может его слышать...
description.vi: Hiiragi Tsukino là một cô bạn bị khiếm thính bẩm sinh. Khi cậu ấy chuyển đến trường mới, cậu ấy gặp được một cậu bạn lắm mồm tên Enomoto Taiyo. Tại đây, Tsukino luôn bị xoay tròn bởi những câu chuyện xàm xí của Taiyo bất chấp việc cô không thể nghe được cậu ta nói gì.

description.en:
He's a nice guy, but way too plain...

That's Fukusuke Mogi, who secretly admires Kureha Yua, the most beautiful girl in the class. However, the one rumored to be with Yua is his best friend, Fujisaki Yusei, the ace of the basketball team. Feeling down about being a "mob character" overshadowed by his best friend, Fukusuke discovers another super cute girl who's hidden in Yua's shadow and doesn't stand out—Usuba Amari! "W-Would you... be my friend?" Sharing similar circumstances, Fukusuke and Amari decide to practice "becoming normal" together—what could possibly happen next?
description.id: "Kisah Romantis Komedi Dimulai dari Persahabatan dengan Heroine Tersembunyi yang Hanya Aku Tahu."Dia anak baik, tapi terlalu biasa saja… Itulah Fukusuke Mogi, yang diam-diam mengagumi Kureha Yua, gadis tercantik di kelas.Namun, orang yang digosipkan bersama Yui adalah sahabatnya, Fujisaki Yuusei, bintang tim basket. Saat merasa terpuruk karena menjadi "karakter figuran" yang tenggelam di balik sahabatnya, Fukusuke menemukan seorang gadis super imut lainnya, yang tersembunyi di balik bayang-bayang Yua dan jarang diperhatikan—Usuha Amari!"A-Apakah… kamu mau jadi temanku?"Berbagi nasib yang serupa, Fukusuke dan Amari memutuskan untuk mulai berlatih "menjadi orang biasa" bersama—kira-kira apa yang akan terjadi selanjutnya?
description.ja:
気がつけば、君のほうを目で追っていた。

いいヤツだけど地味すぎる男子・茂木福助は、学年1の美少女・呉羽結愛に憧れを抱いていた。しかし、結愛と噂になっているのは、福助の親友でバスケ部エースの藤崎勇星。昔から親友の陰に埋もれるモブ……そんな自分に落ち込む福助が見つけたのは、結愛の陰に隠れて誰にも気づかれない、コミュ力0の美少女・薄葉あまりで――?
description.tr:
İyi bir adam ama fazla sıradan...

İşte bu; sınıftaki en güzel kızı, Kureha Yua'yı, seven Fukusuke Mogi. Ancak Yua ile birlikte olduğu söylentileri dolaşan kişi ise Fukusuke'nin en iyi arkadaşı ve basketbol takımının yıldızı olan Fujisaki Yusei. Bir "arka plan karakteri" olduğu ve en iyi arkadaşının gölgesinde kaldığı için üzülen Fukusuke, Yua'nın gölgesinde kalmış ve kendini belli etmeyen çok şirin bir kızı keşfetti - Usuba Amari! "A-Arkadaşım... olur musun?" Benzer durumları paylaşan Fukusuke ve Amari, birlikte "normal olma" alıştırmaları yapmaya karar verdiler. Bu karardan sonra neler olmuş olabilir?
description.vi:
【Câu chuyện tình yêu bắt đầu từ tình bạn, giữa tôi và một "nữ chính ẩn giấu" mà chỉ mình tôi biết.】

Cậu bạn tốt bụng nhưng quá mờ nhạt – đó chính là Mogi Fukusuke, người thầm đem lòng ngưỡng mộ Kureha Yua, cô gái xinh đẹp nhất lớp.
Thế nhưng, người được đồn đại rằng có quan hệ với Yui lại là Fujisaki Yūsei, bạn thân của Fukusuke và cũng là ace của đội bóng rổ.
Trong lúc Fukusuke đang chán nản vì bản thân chỉ là một nhân vật phụ lu mờ bên cạnh người bạn tài giỏi, cậu đã phát hiện ra một cô gái siêu dễ thương khác – Usuha Amari, người luôn ẩn mình sau ánh hào quang của Yua và ít ai chú ý đến...?

「T-tớ... tớ muốn... trở thành bạn với cậu...」
description.es-la:
Fukusuke, un chico agradable pero un poco aburrido, se enamora a primera vista de Yua, la chica más hermosa de la clase. Sin embargo, se rumorea que Yua está interesada en Yusei, el amigo de la infancia de Fukusuke y la estrella del equipo de baloncesto. 

Fukusuke suspira por un amor imposible. Pero, un día, Fukusuke descubre a una chica adorable, llamada Amari Usuha, que es tímida y se esconde tras la sombra de Yua. "Um, ¿quieres ser mi amigo?" Y entonces, los dos empiezan a practicar juntos para "ser normales", pero... "¿Es cierto que Amari-chan está enamorada de Yusei?" "......." "¿Por qué te sonrojas tanto?" 

Una comedia romántica que comienza con amistad, entre un chico aburrido y una chica secretamente adorable, solamente conocida por él. 
(Un pequeño manga para promocionar la novela)
description.pt-br:
Fukusuke, um garoto simpático, mas um pouco chato, se apaixona à primeira vista por Yua, a garota mais linda da turma. No entanto, há rumores de que Yua está interessada em Yusei, amigo de infância de Fukusuke e estrela do time de basquete.

Fukusuke anseia por um amor impossível. Mas, um dia, Fukusuke descobre uma garota adorável, chamada Amari Usuha, que é tímida e se esconde atrás da sombra de Yua. "Hum, você quer ser meu amigo?" E então, os dois começam a praticar juntos para “ser normais”, mas... “É verdade que Amari-chan está apaixonada por Yusei?” "....." "Por que você está corando tanto?"

Uma comédia romântica que começa com uma amizade, entre um garoto chato e uma garota secretamente adorável, que só ele conhece.

description.en:
“Let’s make a warm home!” A renovation × romance drama about building a beloved home together with a gyaru.

Kazukage is suddenly presented with a divorce, accused of domestic violence he has no recollection of, and loses the home he could return to. At that moment, a cheerful gyaru calls out to him, “You can stay at my place.” She turns out to be Karen, his childhood friend who used to play “secret base” together with him when they were kids.

However, the house Karen leads him to is an old traditional house with years of wear—nothing like what one would expect from a gyaru.

While renovating the old house, the two gradually repair their wounded hearts and their relationship, rebuilding them anew.

Just like the secret base they once had.
description.ja:
**あったかいおうち作ろっ！**
**ギャルと愛しいわが家を築いていく、**
**リノベ×恋愛ドラマ**

description.en:
One day, Yuki, a university student, is in trouble when she is rescued by Itsuomi, a senior student at the same university. Even though Yuki is deaf due to a hearing impairment, Itsuomi is unfazed and treats her naturally. Yuki gradually becomes aware of Itsuomi, who makes her feel a new world...

---
Yuki is a typical college student, whose world revolves around her friends, social media, and the latest sales. But when a chance encounter on a train leads to her meeting friend-of-a-friend and fellow student Itsuomi-san, her world starts to widen. But even though Itsuomi-kun can speak three languages, sign language isn't one of them. Can the two learn to communicate the budding feelings between them?
description.es: La vida de Yuki, una universitaria con sordera, va a dar un vuelco cuando en su camino se cruce el joven Itsuomi, un muchacho que, a pesar de dominar varios idiomas, no conoce la lengua de signos japonesa. Itsuomi se interesa enseguida en Yuki y desea aprender la lengua de signos y, sobre todo, entrar en el mundo de ella. Signos de afecto es una historia de amor sobre la necesidad de la comunicación, sobre el aprendizaje de las diferencias y sobre la empatía.
description.fr:
Yuki est une étudiante qui, comme beaucoup d'autres, construit son quotidien autour de ses amis, des réseaux sociaux et de ce qu'elle aime. Mais quand un jour, dans le train, elle croise un jeune homme qui voyage à travers le monde, son univers va être chamboulé: ce dernier, bien que trilingue, ne connaît pas la langue des signes. Pourtant, très vite, il manifestera pour elle un intérêt bien particulier… Comment réagira-t-elle face à ce camarade d'université entreprenant et communicatif?

A sign of affection décrit avec pudeur et simplicité l'histoire d'amour entre une jeune femme sourde et un grand voyageur. à n'en pas douter, les personnages de ce manga ne manqueront pas de vous émouvoir!
description.it: Un giorno, in un momento di difficoltà, una studentessa universitaria di nome Yuki viene aiutata da Itsuomi, un senpai che frequenta il suo stesso istituto. Il giovane la tratta con grande naturalezza e non si scompone minimamente quando capisce che la ragazza è sorda. Ben presto, Yuki scoprirà di provare qualcosa per quel ragazzo, grazie al quale ha cominciato a percepire la realtà in maniera del tutto nuova...
description.ja: 女子大生の雪は、ある日困っているところを同じ大学の先輩・逸臣に助けてもらう。聴覚障がいがあって耳が聴こえない雪にも動じることなく、自然に接してくれる逸臣。自分に新しい世界を感じさせてくれる逸臣のことを雪は次第に意識し始めて…！？

description.pt: Yuki é uma típica estudante universitária que nasceu surda. Ela ama estar perto dos seus amigos, redes sociais e fazer compras. "Neste dia, Yuki sentiu o seu mundo mudar."
description.ru: Это нежная история о любви между глухонемой девушкой и парнем, говорящем на нескольких языках и облетевшем мир, как много они могут привнести и изменить в мирах друг друга? Ицуоми выручает Юки, оказывается, что они учатся в одном университете. Случайная встреча, заинтересованность, стремление, желание… Что же Юки постепенно осознает?..

description.en:
Monster weaves the riveting story of the brilliant Dr. Kenzo Tenma, a famous surgeon with a promising career at a leading hospital. Tenma risks his reputation and promising career to save the life of a critically wounded young boy. Unbeknownst to him, this child is destined for a terrible fate. 

A string of strange and mysterious murders begin to occur soon afterward, ones that professionally benefit Dr. Tenma, and he emerges as the primary suspect. Conspiracies, serial murders, and a scathing depiction of the underbelly of hospital politics are all masterfully woven together in this compelling manga thriller.

---
**Awards Won:**

- Winner of the Excellence Prize at the [Japan Media Arts Festival](https://j-mediaarts.jp/en/award/index-2.html) in 1997.
- Winner of the Grand Prize at the 3rd [Osamu Tezuka Cultural Prize](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tezuka_Osamu_Cultural_Prize) in 1999.
- Winner of the 46th [Shogakukan Manga Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shogakukan_Manga_Award) for General Manga in 2000.
- Winner of the [Lucca Comics Awards](https://luccacomicsawards.com/albo-doro-2/) for Best Manga Series in 2004.

---
See [MyAnimeList](https://myanimelist.net/anime/19/Monster) for the Anime Adaptation.

description.ru:
Один день изменил жизнь доктора Тэнмы Кэндзо, гениального японского хирурга, прибывшего в Германию для работы в госпитале «Эйслер Мемориал». В этот день он понял, что человеческие жизни равноценны, и что сама человеческая жизнь стоит больше, чем выгода, которую можно получить за её спасение. В этот день он спас мальчика, получившего огнестрельное ранение в голову во время убийства его родителей. Через некоторое время произошло ещё три убийства, и доктор Тэнма стал главой хирургического отделения госпиталя. В суматохе этих дней выживший после великолепной операции, проведённой нашим Айболитом, мальчик и его сестра-близнец бесследно исчезли из больницы.  
  
Прошло девять лет, и убийства в Дюссельдорфе начались вновь. Монстр появился в городе. И в жизни Тэнмы, чтобы в один дождливый вечер сказать: «Ты — тот, кто вернул меня к жизни, доктор…»
description.tr:

Tenma, ağır yaralı bir gencin hayatını kurtarmak için itibarını ve gelecek vadeden kariyerini riske atar. Kendisinin haberi yoktur ancak bu çocuk korkunç bir kadere mahkûmdur.  
  
Kısa süre sonra, Dr. Tenma'ya profesyonel olarak fayda sağlayan bir dizi tuhaf ve gizemli cinayet meydana gelmeye başlar ve birincil şüpheli olarak ortaya çıkar. Komplolar, seri cinayetler ve hastane siyasetinin kötü bir tasviri, bu ilgi çekici gerilim serisinde ustalıkla bir araya getirilmiştir.  
Note: Won the 46th Shogakukan Manga Award in the general category.

**Name In Native Language:** 浦沢直樹

Urasawa Naoki (born January 2, 1960) is a Japanese manga artist and musician. He has been drawing manga since he was four years old, and for most of his professional career has created two series simultaneously. The stories to many of these were co-written in collaboration with his former editor, Takashi Nagasaki. Urasawa has been called one of the artists that changed the history of manga and has won numerous awards, including the Shogakukan Manga Award three times, the Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize twice, and the Kodansha Manga Award once. By 2016, his various works had over 126 million copies in circulation.

His early style was inspirational and warm youth growth manga, and then turned to a deep discussion of human nature and social phenomena, covering topics such as history, psychology, criminology and science fiction. He was a 1960s and 1970s rock fan. It's influence can be strongly reflected in the *20th Century Boys*. He likes Bob Dylan very much.

Jill Savelle- seorang tunangan dari pangeran putra mahkota Gerald de Kleitos yang memiliki gelar "Dewi Perang"- telah diburu oleh negaranya sendiri yang telah dilindunginya. Sekarang, sebagai seorang gadis berusia 10 tahun, Jill memutuskan untuk melarikan diri dari pertunangan dengan pangeran yang menghampirinya. Dan pada akhirnya, dia secara tidak sengaja melamar pria berumur 19 tahun yang dikenal sebagai kaisar naga hades theos rave, yang nantinya akan menghancurkan negaranya. Tapi tanpa disangka, dia malah menerima lamarannya!

description.en:
Minamino Chinatsu is a beautiful girl who's incredibly popular and easygoing. Ever since I met her in the fall of my first year of high school, my life has been anything but ordinary. It all changed when another guy with the same name as me showed up at school – a handsome one, no less – and suddenly my classmates started calling me 'Number Two.'

"You're not 'Number Two' to me," she said. "Besides, it's me who wants to kiss you first."

My relationship with Chinatsu goes beyond just school. We play street basketball after class, cook meals together, share secrets, and even grow physically closer. I thought I was fine being alone, but she accepts me for who I am. And because of that, I want to give her the same in return.

This is a coming-of-age love story about realizing how precious even the simplest desires can be.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Tudo mudou quando outro cara com o mesmo nome que eu apareceu na escola – um bonitão, nada mais, nada menos – e de repente meus colegas começaram a me chamar de "Número Dois".

Meu relacionamento com Chinatsu vai além da escola. Jogamos basquete de rua depois da aula, cozinhamos juntos, compartilhamos segredos e até nos aproximamos fisicamente. Eu achava que estava tudo bem sozinho, mas ela me aceita como eu sou. E por isso, quero retribuir o mesmo.

Esta é uma história de amor sobre amadurecimento, sobre perceber o quão preciosos até os desejos mais simples podem ser.

She is now Myne, the sickly five-year-old daughter of a poor soldier. To make things worse, the world she's been reborn in has a very low literacy rate and books mostly don't exist. She'd have to pay an enormous amounts of money to buy one. Myne resolves herself: If there aren't any books, she'll just have to make them! Her goal is to become a librarian. This story begins with her quest to make books so she can live surrounded by them! Dive into this biblio-fantasy written for book lovers and bookworms!

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 香月美夜

Kazuki began crafting novels during her second year of junior high. After successfully navigating an entrance exam, she entered a national university. However, the demands of work interrupted her writing pursuits. It wasn't until she married and her child started kindergarten that Kazuki found herself with more free time, allowing her to rekindle her passion for writing. In 2013, she commenced publishing her novel "Ascendance of a Bookworm" on the user-generated platform Shōsetsuka ni Narō, achieving notable success. By 2015, she officially debuted with the same series under the T.O. Books imprint.

From 2015 to 2017, she wrote a series of essays for "Everyone's Library" (みんなの図書館, Minna no Toshokan), a journal released by The Society of Study on Library Problems.

In a far-off corner of another world where only nobles can use magic, a certain thirty-something salaryman is reincarnated as a five-year-old village boy named Ren.

For him, the slow-paced countryside life is peaceful and enjoyable—that is, until a group of adorable but terrifying little angels (a.k.a. troublemaking children) takes a liking to him.

Even though he just wants to be lazy, he ends up doing things perfectly—like playing hide-and-seek from morning till night, reading stories aloud, and calming their wailing cries—because he's just too good at taking care of others!

One day, while thinking of ways to slack off more, a monster suddenly attacks their once-peaceful village. And when the problem children are put in danger, the usually unmotivated Ren unleashes a hidden power he's kept secret—just to avoid getting dragged into more trouble!

A laid-back reincarnated boy ends up babysitting (and saving the kingdom) in this reluctant hero’s tale!
description.id:
Di dunia lain di mana hanya kaum bangsawan yang bisa menggunakan sihir, tepatnya di daerah terpencil yang terlupakan.
Seorang karyawan kantoran berusia 30-an telah bereinkarnasi menjadi Ren (5 tahun), seorang anak desa biasa.
Baginya, kehidupan santai di pedesaan terasa menyenangkan.
Setidaknya sampai dia dikerubungi para "Malaikat Kejam" (Pretty Angel)...
Padahal dia ingin bermalas-malasan, tapi dari pagi hingga malam dia harus bermain petak umpet, membacakan cerita, menenangkan tangisan, dan sebagainya. Karena sifatnya yang perhatian, tanpa sadar dia melakukan semuanya dengan sempurna!
"Tidak bisa begini terus," pikirnya sambil mencari cara untuk bisa bermalas-malasan. Namun suatu hari, desa yang damai tiba-tiba diserang monster.
Ketika anak-anak bandel itu terancam bahaya, Ren yang biasanya tidak pernah bersemangat, akhirnya menggunakan kekuatan yang selama ini dia sembunyikan untuk menghindari masalah—!
Kisah heroik seorang pemuda reinkarnasi santai yang (sambil mengeluh) menjaga anak-anak (dan menyelamatkan negeri)!

description.en:
One day, Gard, a servant of a count's family, was framed for a crime he did not commit and was fired from his job.

"You're worse than trash! Get out of this house immediately!"

Expelled from the Count's family and with nowhere to go, Gard saw a flyer recruiting students for Remillion Magic Academy and decided to take the entrance exam in the royal capital. It was said to be the most difficult exam to enter a magic academy, but Gard passed it with ease. How could this happen to Gard, who was just a servant!? Yes, in his previous life, Gard was actually the "strongest sage"!

description.en:
Girls and sweets are full of secrets!? 

Ichinose Souma is a high school student who dreams of becoming a pastry chef and devotes himself to making sweets. He meets Satomi Chika, a female classmate, after receiving some sweets. Chika is a beautiful girl with a soothing personality, known at school as the "Angel of Peace." Souma thought she was a good girl who would kindly listen to his worries about making sweets, but...

"Ichinose-san, your embarrassed face is really cute."

Chika shows an unexpected side of herself only when they are alone, and Souma's heart is on the verge of exploding!
description.ja: パティシエになることを夢見てお菓子作りにはげむ高校生・市瀬颯真。 彼はお菓子の差し入れをきっかけに、クラスメイトの女子・里見千佳と出会う。 千佳は校内で“安らぎの天使”と呼ばれる癒し系の美少女。 颯真のお菓子作りの悩みも優しく聞いてくれるいい子、だと思っていたのだが―― 「……市瀬さんの恥ずかしがる顔って、すごく可愛いんですね」 ふたりきりの時だけ意外な一面を見せてくる千佳に、颯真の心は爆発寸前！
description.vi:
Satomi Chika hay còn được gọi là [Thiên sứ hoà bình] vừa xinh đẹp vừa đáng yêu. Ichinose Souma là một chàng trai thích làm đồ ngọt.

Souma đã nhờ Chika nếm thử đồ ngọt mình làm và đổi lại cậu phải trông chừng cô bạn cùng lớp này.

"Tớ muốn làm thử rất nhiều thứ đấy."

"Ichinose-kun, khi xấu hổ mặt cậu đáng yêu lắm luôn."

Không biết vì sao một Chika đáng yêu, rụt rè lại trêu chọc Souma không thương tiếc. Thanh xuân của họ dần trở nên ngọt ngào hơn!?

Câu chuyện hài hước nhưng không kém phần lãng mạng giữa 'cô nàng thiên sứ tinh nghịch' và 'chàng trai mang ước mơ cháy bỏng' bắt đầu...
description.pt-br:
Meninas e doces estão cheios de segredos!? 

Ichinose Souma é um estudante do ensino médio que sonha em ser confeiteiro e se dedica à confecção de doces. Ele conhece Satomi Chika, uma colega de classe, após receber alguns doces. 

Chika é uma linda garota com uma personalidade calmante, conhecida na escola como o “Anjo da Paz”. Souma achava que ela era uma boa garota que ouviria gentilmente suas preocupações sobre fazer doces, mas... 

"Ichinose-san, seu rosto envergonhado é muito fofo." 

Chika mostra um lado inesperado de si mesma apenas quando estão sozinhos, e o coração de Souma está prestes a explodir! Começa uma doce e estimulante história de Garoto conhece Garota com um anjo travesso conectado por doces!

description.en: Kurumi Yoshizawa, the student council president, has excellent grades and an inviting, friendly personality... on the surface at least. In reality, her days are spent struggling against her domineering mother and agonizing over her teachers' expectations. One day, Kurumi reluctantly goes to meet Naoi, her truant classmate, at her homeroom teacher's request to look after her. The situation sours quickly as Naoi sees through Kurumi's facade and makes her animosity clear. On the verge of a meltdown, Kurumi is barely able to stop herself from shoplifting, unaware that she's being recorded by Naoi…
description.ja: 吉沢来未は生徒会長も務める優等生だが、母の束縛などのストレスで破滅的な願望を募らせていた。ある日、教師の頼みで不登校気味なクラスメイト・直井と話をするが、上辺だけの言葉で話す吉沢を直井は蔑み、更には「ある動画」で脅してきた。その動画には、万引きをしようとする吉沢が映っていて…。
description.pl:
Kurumi Yoshizawa, przewodnicząca samorządu uczniowskiego, otwarta, ambitna, życzliwa... a przynajmniej na taką się kreuje. Rzeczywistość wygląda jednak mniej rózowo - w szkole musi zmagać się z nadmiernymi oczekiwaniami nauczycieli, a w domu czeka na nią toksyczna matka.

Pewnego dnia Kurumi, na prośbę wychowawcy, udaje się do Naoi, swojej wagarującej koleżanki z klasy. Sprawy przybierają zupełnie niespodziewany obrót, gdy Naoi dostrzega fasadę Kurumi i jasno wyraża swoją wrogość wobec niej. Będąc na skraju załamania nerwowego, Kurumi powstanawia dokonać drobnej kradzieży, przed czym w ostatniej chwili się powstrzymuje. Nie ma pojęcia, że całe te zajście nagrała Naoi.

To brutalna opowieść o dwóch młodych dziewczynach, które każdego dnia zmagają się z codziennością, od której nie mogą się wyrwać.
description.tr: Öğrenci Konseyi başkanu Kurumi Yoshizawa derslerinde oldukça başarılı, sıcakkanlı ve arkadaş canlısı bir kişiliğe sahip... yani en azından dışarıdan bakılınca. Aslında günleri baskıcı annesiyle yaşadığı zorluklar ve öğretmenlerinin beklentilerinin acılarıyla geçiyor. Kurumi bir gün sınıf öğretmeninin isteğiyle çekinerek okula gelmeyen sınıf arkadaşı Naoi ile tanışmaya gidiyor. Naoi ise Kurumi'nin maskesinin ardındakini kolayca gördükten sonra işler hızlıca tatsızlaşıyor. Çökmenin eşiğine gelen Kurumi kendini hırsızlık yapmaktan son anda kurtarıyor ancak bu sırada Naoi'nin kendini kayda aldığından habersiz...
description.uk:
Вітайте, Йошізава Курумі – відмінниця, розумниця, красуня, президент школи та просто дуже гарна дівчинка!.. Принаймні такою вона себе показує людям. Реальність прозаїчніша: жорстокі методи виховання матері, відсутність будь-якого вільного часу, море стресу та щира відраза до всіх навколо.
І як часто буває з такими «відмінницями» – накипіло. «Що, якщо я це вкраду? Мене спіймають? Може, тоді цей жах нарешті скінчиться?» – стоїть і думає Курумі, не усвідомлюючи, що її спроба крадіжки записується на відео. Проте її знімають не камери відеоспостереження крамниці, а телефон Наой.
Наой – це дівчина, яка за словами не слідкує, до школи не ходить та обожнює ставити «відмінниць» на місце. Вона бачить абсолютно все крізь маску Курумі, погрожуючи показати відео однокласникам. Для Наой це був хіба що спосіб розвіяти нудьгу та провчити лицемірку… Допоки вона не починає бачити в Курумі лиш одне, але чисте та справжнє спільне бажання.

description.en:
Q: Why did you choose this high school?
A: Because my future wife is enrolling here.

When I woke up, I had time-leaped 15 years into the past. Standing before me was Yuki, my future wife, wearing a school uniform. In the original timeline, we wouldn't meet until we became adults and eventually got married, so we're still strangers for now. But I know that she distrusts people, has no friends, and spends her school days alone. I also know she'll deeply regret that time in the future. So this time, I'm going to rewrite her youth. "How do you know my secret!?" "Because we're husband and wife... in the future."

Saat terbangun, aku mendapati diriku telah kembali ke masa lalu 15 tahun. Di hadapanku berdiri Yuki, wanita yang kelak menjadi istriku, mengenakan seragam sekolah. Dalam alur waktu semula, kami baru akan bertemu setelah dewasa dan akhirnya menikah, jadi untuk saat ini kami masih orang asing. Namun, aku tahu bahwa Yuki tidak memercayai orang lain, tidak punya teman, dan menjalani masa sekolahnya seorang diri. Aku juga tahu bahwa suatu hari nanti ia akan sangat menyesali masa itu. Karena itulah kali ini aku akan menulis ulang masa mudanya. "Kenapa kamu tahu rahasiaku?!" "Karena kita suami istri... di masa depan." Ini adalah kisah tentang bagaimana aku mewarnai kembali masa muda kelabu calon istriku dengan warnaku sendiri.

Ryuuji who was an orphan was picked up and raised by the world's strongest evil dragon. When he turned 15, he had intended to leave the house and be independent, but his mother proclaims that to do so he must defeat her. "You're lvl 999! How the hell am I supposed to do that?!" Somehow, he manages to persuade her and he is allowed to journey out, however, she ends up joining him as his companion.

"You wish to join my son's party? Then you'll have to pass the interview with me."
"An extermination quest? It's dangerous, so let your mother handle this."

Due to the overprotective mother by his side, suffering and misfortune continue to pour. Will he be able to stand on his own as an adventurer and as a man?

"Sen 999. seviyedesin! Bunu nasıl yapabilirim ki?!"     Bir şekilde onu ikna etmeyi başarır ve yolculuğa çıkmasına izin verilir, ancak annesi ona yoldaş olarak katılır.     "Oğlumun partisine katılmak mı istiyorsun? O zaman benimle yapacağın görüşmeyi geçmen gerekecek."   "Bir imha görevi mi? Tehlikeli, o yüzden bırak annen halletsin."   "Zindan keşfi mi? Oradaki küçük yavruları çoktan temizledim."     Yanındaki aşırı korumacı annesi yüzünden acı ve talihsizlik yağmaya devam ediyor. Bir maceracı ve bir erkek olarak kendi başına ayakta durabilecek mi?

"If you let us stay... you can do naughty things with us."

Mitsuhiko Okaya, an unremarkable man, was betrayed by his wife and a junior colleague. At work, he was mocked as a useless editor and spiraled into despair, until one day before him appeared a pair of twin high school girls he shouldn't know, yet somehow seemed familiar. The younger twin, Akari, was lively, cheerful, and always teasing him, while the elder twin, Nanako, was shy and clumsy, yet secretly a closet pervert. They were once his students from the cram school where he worked during his student days.
description.id:
"Kalau kamu membiarkan kami menginap... kamu boleh melakukan hal apapun ke kita."
Mitsuhiko Okaya, seorang pria biasa, dikhianati oleh istrinya dan kouhainya di kantor. Di tempat kerja, dia dihina sebagai editor tak berguna dan tenggelam dalam keputusasaan, sampai suatu hari di hadapannya muncul sepasang gadis kembar berseragam SMA yang seharusnya asing, tapi entah kenapa terasa familiar.  Si adik, Akari, ceria, aktif, dan suka menggoda dengan santai, sedangkan kakaknya, Nanako, pemalu dan canggung, tapi diam-diam mesum.  ...Mereka ternyata adalah mantan murid bimbelnya saat masa kuliah dulu.

description.de: Sachi kommt mit ihren Eltern nicht klar und will einfach nur weg. Deshalb täuscht sie gemeinsam mit dem Typen, der sie immer stalkt, eine Entführung vor. Versteckt in dessen Einzimmer-Appartment machen die beiden einen Deal: Wenn sie mit der Entführungsnummer durchkommen, wird geheiratet...
description.en:
One day, a fourteen year-old girl was kidnapped… or so the police have been lead to believe. Actually, she tried to run away from her abusive parents and was helped by her stalker who then shelters her in his apartment. Although he considers his actions as kidnapping, the girl is happy about the situation and proposes to him, with the condition that if they are caught, they will commit suicide.

---
One day, a girl was kidnapped. However, that girl started to desire a life living with her captor, and swears that she will marry him. In return, her captor provides her with happiness that she had always longed for. How could a story between a girl and her captor be so heart warming?
description.es: Tras ser secuestrada, una chica desgraciada es feliz por primera vez. El día que la secuestran empieza una vida con un hilo de esperanza. Ella le promete a su secuestrador que se casarán y él le ofrece felicidad. ¿Cómo pueden tener una relación tan cálida siendo un secuestrador y su víctima?
description.id:
"Kalau berhasil lolos, kita akan menikah. Kalau tertangkap, kita mati bersama..."

description.it:
Un giorno una ragazza di quattordici anni viene rapita. O almeno è quello che la polizia crede. In realtà la ragazza ha provato a fuggire dai violenti genitori e ha trovato rifugio… dal suo stalker, che ora la ospita nel suo appartamento.

Per quanto lui continui a pensare di aver commesso un rapimento, la ragazza è felice di quello che è successo e si dichiara a lui, promettendo che, in caso di cattura, si toglieranno la vita insieme.
description.ja:
薄幸な少女は誘拐されて“幸せ"を初めて知る。

その日、少女は誘拐された。
しかし、それは少女にとって一縷の希望にかけた生活の始まりだった。
少女は誘拐犯に結婚を誓い、誘拐犯は少女にたくさんの“幸せ"を捧ぐ。
被害者と誘拐犯の関係なのに―――どうしてこんなに温かいの?

description.pl: W mediach zawrzało. Wieść o zaginionej nastolatce rozniosła się w mgnieniu oka. Policja nie wyklucza porwania. Nikt nie przypuszcza, że płaczący przed kamerą rodzice, od lat znęcali się nad córką. Nie mogąc dłużej tego znieść dziewczyna uciekła z domu i znalazła schronienie pod dachem tajemniczego młodego mężczyzny. Ściany pokoju, w którym teraz mieszka zdobi mozaika zdjęć zrobionych jej z ukrycia. Wybawcą nastolatki jest bowiem jej własny stalker. Choć dziewczyna przebywa z nim dobrowolnie i może odejść w każdej chwili, obydwoje zdają sobie sprawę, że jeśli ktoś pozna ich sekret, mężczyzna natychmiast zostanie skazany za porwanie. Nastolatka proponuje więc swojemu wybawcy niezwykły układ - jeśli zdołają ukryć się do czasu, gdy uzyska pełnoletniość, wezmą ślub. Jeśli złapie ich policja - obydwoje popełnią samobójstwo. Jaki będzie finał tej dramatycznej historii?

description.en:
An ex-pro gamer of the FPS genre (♂) reincarnated in a fantasy world filled with magic... Only to learn that what greeted him was not a scene from one's dreams, but a muddy battlefield full of bullets flying to and fro! Moreover, he's now an orphan girl named Touri Noel!?

After her aptitude for healing magic was discovered, she decided to volunteer in the army as a second-class medic, all to raise money for the orphanage where she was born and raised. However, without even getting magic training, she was attached to an assault squad, repeatedly fighting on the most cruel battlefields of the "Western Front." The mission given to her was to become the personal medic of the frontline's ace, Garback, and not let him die at any cost. But he turned out to be the worst commander, who will try to get results whatever the cost, even if it means the death of his subordinates!

On the battlefield, mired in unreasonable orders and violence, Touri's fierce battle for survival continues...
description.ja:
FPSの元プロゲーマー♂が転生した世界は魔法が存在するファンタジー世界だった――が、そこには夢広がる冒険はなく、銃弾が飛び交う泥沼の戦場が待っていた！しかも、トウリ・ノエルという名の孤児の「少女」として……！？

トウリは回復魔法への適性を見出され、生まれ育った孤児院への資金援助のため軍に志願し二等衛生兵となる。しかし魔法の訓練も受けないまま、彼女は最も過酷な戦闘が繰り広げられている「西部戦線」の突撃部隊へと配属されてしまう。彼女に与えられた任務は戦線のエースであるガーバックの専属衛生兵となり、絶対に彼を死なせないこと。けれどガーバックは部下を見殺しにしてでも戦果を上げる最低の指揮官でもあった！

理不尽な命令と暴力が飛び交う戦場で、トウリはただ生き残るために奮闘するが――。

托莉被發掘出擁有使用恢復魔法的適性，進而自願從軍，成為二等醫護兵。

Dort war Makia eine gewöhnliche, japanische Oberschülerin, die gemeinsam mit zwei anderen Klassenkameraden umgebracht wurde. description.id: Makia adalah seorang gadis bangsawan yang merupakan keturunan dari seorang penyihir yang dikenal akan kejahatannya. Keduanya terpaksa harus berpisah karena suatu alasan, dan ketika mereka berdua dipertemukan kembali, Makia bertekad untuk menjadi murid terbaik yang ada di sekolah sihir! ---
description.ja: 大魔術師たちが世界を動かす「メイデーア」で、最凶最悪の魔女として伝説となっている”紅の魔女”。その末裔のマキアが夢で見る女子高校生・小田一華（かずは）は転生前のマキアの姿で、一華は何者かに殺されていた…。
description.ru: Загадочный мир под названием «Мейдер». В нём существуют магия, рыцари, драконы и… ведьмы. Макия – юная волшебница из дворянской семьи, являющаяся потомком «Самой худшей ведьмы этого мира», и любительница провести вечерок-другой, изучая новые заклинания. Однажды она встречает необычного паренька, которому даёт имя Тор. Вместе они продолжают углубляться в исследование колдовства и довольно быстро находят общий язык. Это начало длинной истории о девочке, пытающейся понять себя и свои истинные чувства.

On her deathbed, a sickly young girl wishes to be reborn with a strong body that will never succumb to anyone or anything. Lo and behold, her wish is granted! Upon reincarnating into another world as Mary Regalia, she discovers her new body has maxed-out attributes, from physical strength to defense—even magic. But wait! That isn't what she really wanted! All she longed for was a normal life. Baffled by God's choice to grant her wish in this most unexpected way, Mary tries to spend her days as uneventfully as possible. The hitch is... nothing's harder than living a normal life when you're absolutely invincible!

Trên giường bệnh, một cô gái trẻ ốm yếu mong muốn được tái sinh với một cơ thể mạnh mẽ sẽ không bao giờ khuất phục trước bất kỳ ai hay bất kỳ điều gì. Thật bất ngờ, điều ước của cô đã thành hiện thực! Khi đầu thai vào một thế giới khác với thân phận Mary Regalia, cô phát hiện ra cơ thể mới của mình có các thuộc tính tối đa, từ sức mạnh thể chất, đến phòng thủ và thậm chí cả phép thuật. Nhưng khoan đã! Đó không phải là điều cô thực sự muốn! Tất cả những gì cô khao khát là một cuộc sống bình thường... nhưng đó là một nhiệm vụ khó khăn khi bạn hoàn toàn bất khả chiến bại! Hãy cùng Mary khám phá cuộc sống mới của cô với tư cách là con gái của một công tước, kết bạn với đủ loại người—bao gồm cả người hầu gái tận tụy, một hiệp sĩ tập sự bất kính, một cô gái pháp sư kiêu hãnh và thậm chí cả hoàng tử của vương quốc—chiến đấu với những con quái vật đáng sợ, và thậm chí có thể bị nhầm là một hiệp sĩ trong truyền thuyết!

description.en:
Tousuke Rokudou is a loser, and everyone knows it. He gets picked on at school, gets snide looks from passersbys, and can only muster up the courage to complain in secret with his equally hapless friends. Looking to turn his life around, he desperately uses an ancestral artifact passed down in his family for generations: a scroll that is capable of subduing all demons. However, in the modern age, it has a different effect: it makes all bad girls fall in love with him.  
  
…And then, things go **ballistic** when he meets the delinquent beast-on-a-girl's-body Ranna Himawari, who hopelessly falls deep for him.  
  
See Rokudou traverse through a school life filled with delinquents, turf wars, backstabbing, and as the song goes, *"Everybody Was Kung Fu Fighting!!!"*

description.en:
Civilization is dead, but Chito and Yuuri are still alive. 
So they hop aboard their Kettenkrad motorbike and aimlessly wander the ruins of the world they once knew. 
Day after hopeless day, they look for their next meal and fuel for their ride. 
But as long as they are together, even an existence as bleak as theirs has a ray or two of sunshine in it, 
whether they're sucking down their fill of soup or hunting for machine parts to tinker with. 
The experiences and feelings these two girls share in a world full of nothing give them something to live for…  
  
---
- **Won the Seiun Award for Best Comic in 2019**
description.id:
Peradaban tewas, tapi Chito dan Yuuri masih hidup. Jadi mereka naik sepeda motor Kettenkrad tersayang mereka dan bermondar-mandir tanpa tujuan reruntuhan dunia yang mereka dulu kenal. Hari demi hari tanpa harapan, mereka mencari makanan berikut mereka dan bensin untuk kendaraan mereka. Tapi selama mereka berdua bersama, bahkan kehidupan seguram mereka masih ada sedikit kesenangan di dalamnya, entah minum sup entah mencari bagian-bagian mesin untuk menggerumit. Untuk dua putri di dalam dunia kosong, pengalaman dan perasaan keduanya bersama ada memberi mereka alasan untuk hidup...

- Pemenang Penghargaan Seiun (Nebula) Jepang dalam kategori Komik/Manga terbaik di 2019.
description.ru:
Мир будущего. Человеческая цивилизация достигла невероятного технологического прогресса и однажды построила себе гигантские многоуровневые города, в которых проживало огромное количество людей. Однако через какое-то время началась война, после которой человечество оказалось на грани вымирания.
Спустя много лет в одном из таких городов мы встречаем Тито и Юри. Эти две маленькие девочки изо дня в день путешествуют на своём модифицированном Kettenkrad в поисках пропитания и ресурсов.
Движимые желанием забраться на самую вершину этого опустевшего города-исполина, они постоянно сталкиваются со всё новыми и новыми загадочными сооружениями, памятниками истории и культуры и даже с некоторыми другими выжившими. Что же будет ждать их в конце этой длинной дороги?
description.uk: Дівчата Чіто та Юурі — певно, останні вцілілі після війни, що перетворила людську цивілізацію на руїну. Не маючи більше власного дому, дівчата блукають містом на гусеничному мотоциклі «Кеттенкрад», постійно шукаючи ресурси задля виживання. Утім, попри безпросвітне майбутнє, дівчата однаково знаходять способи розважити себе впродовж цієї меланхолійної подорожі.
description.pt-br: A civilização está morta, mas Chito e Yuuri ainda estão vivas. Então elas sobem a bordo de sua amada moto Kettenkrad e calmamente vagam pelas ruínas do mundo. Dia após dia sem esperança, elas procuram a próxima refeição e acumulam combustível para seguir em frente. Mas enquanto elas estiverem juntas, até uma existência tão sombria como esta tem um ou dois raios de sol a brilhar, mesmo que estejam tomando as últimas gotas de uma sopa ou à caça de peças para seu veículo se mexer. Para duas garotas em um mundo cheio de nada, as experiências e os sentimentos que compartilham são a sua força para viver.

description.en:
Yuuto is an ordinary young man who just so happens to be married to Asuka Amou, one of Japan's brightest stars in women's volleyball.

To the public, Asuka is the cool, dependable captain with an outstanding career. But behind closed doors, she's nothing like her flawless image. Around Yuuto, she turns into an incredibly clingy, hopelessly spoiled wife—so adorable that her fans would faint if they ever saw her like this! On top of that, the stress of being an elite athlete has left her with a very high sex drive, making it hard for her to resist getting intimate with her beloved husband.

The problem? A major tournament is just around the corner, and getting pregnant now could derail her career and affect the entire team. Determined to support her dreams, Yuuto insists they hold off on sex for the time being.

Can Asuka really keep her desires in check when the temptation is right beside her? And can Yuuto handle the irresistible charms of his affectionate wife without giving in?
description.id:
Yuuto hanyalah seorang pemuda biasa yang kebetulan menikah dengan Asuka Amou, salah satu bintang paling bersinar di dunia voli putri Jepang.

Di depan publik, Asuka dikenal sebagai kapten yang keren, bisa diandalkan, dan punya karier gemilang. Namun, begitu hanya berdua dengan Yuuto, sosoknya berubah total. Di hadapan suaminya, dia justru menjadi istri yang manja dan sangat lengket, sampai-sampai para penggemarnya mungkin akan pingsan kalau melihat sisi Asuka yang satu ini!

Bukan cuma itu, tekanan sebagai atlet papan atas juga membuat gairah Asuka begitu tinggi sehingga dia kesulitan menahan diri untuk tidak bermesraan dengan suami tercintanya.

Masalahnya, turnamen besar sudah semakin dekat. Jika Asuka sampai hamil sekarang, kariernya bisa terganggu dan bahkan berdampak pada seluruh tim. Demi mendukung impian istrinya, Yuuto bersikeras agar mereka menunda hubungan intim untuk sementara waktu.

Tapi, bisakah Asuka benar-benar menahan hasratnya ketika godaan ada tepat di sampingnya? Dan bisakah Yuuto bertahan menghadapi pesona istrinya yang begitu manja tanpa akhirnya menyerah?

表では輝かしい経歴を持つ飛鳥、しかし、その正体は…優人の前では限界OLばりに甘えまくる、ファンが見たら悶絶するだらしない奥さんだった!! しかも彼女、日ごろからのストレスもあって性欲が強く、ついつい優人とそういう行為をしようとしてしまう!!

しかし大会も近く、今妊娠をしてしまうと迷惑が掛かると考え、エッチは優人に止められてしまう飛鳥。
果たして、分かっていても止められない飛鳥は無事我慢できるのか、そして優人はそんな彼女を受け止めきれるのか!!!?

description.pt-br:
Yuuto é um jovem adulto que se casou com Asuka Amou, uma das jovens mais brilhantes do cenário japonês de vôlei femino.

Para o público, Asuka é rígida, a capitã confiável com uma carreira de dar inveja. Mas por trás das cortinas, tudo isso cai por terra. Ao redor de Yuuto, ela fica extremamente grudenta e entra no modo esposa mimada - tão adorável que seus fãs iriam a loucura caso vissem isso! Acima de tudo, o estresse de ser uma atleta de elite faz com que ela tenha um tesão de outro mundo, resistir se torna uma tarefa quase impossível.

O problema? O torneio principal está logo ali, ficar grávida agora causaria sérios problemas a sua carreira e afetaria todo o time. Determinado a apoiar ela em seus sonhos, Yuuto insiste que eles devem parar de transar por um tempo.

Será que Asuka será capaz de acalmar seus desejos quando a tentação mora junto com ela? E Yuuto conseguirá mesmo se segurar ao ver sua doce e amável esposa pedindo por isso?

description.en:
The Kingdom of Albein was blessed with the appearance of the Miracle children, individuals with the greatest talents ever seen. Despite being around ten years old, with abilities many times stronger than the average adventurer, they managed to reach a strength score exceeding 100,000 points, granting them the adventurer grade SSS. With a mere party of five persons, they defeated the Demon Lord regaining the kingdom's peace.  
  
After that journey, Dick Silver, the most balanced between them, racked his brain to not draw public attention. In the end, he decided to become the guild master of a suburban guild as a reward, becoming its twelfth successor. After five years he reached his aim and then became a regular of his own guild's bar. But one day, as he was drinking at the bar as always, the daughter of a certain aristocrat came to pay him a visit.
